section.title: Evaluating Exponential Expressions
section.para: A power is repeated multiplication of the same factor. The factor is the base, and the number of times the base is used as a factor is the exponent. The expression is called a power.

list.item: five to the power of three

section.para: \(5^3\) means 5 is used as a factor 3 times: \(5^3 =5 \cdot 5 \cdot 5=125\).

list.item:
\(7(3)^4\)
Use order of operations. Evaluate the exponent first.
\(7(3)^4 =7(3 \cdot 3 \cdot 3 \cdot 3)=7(81)\)
Then multiply.
\(7(81)=567\)
\(7(3)^4 =567\)

\(20(0.8)^2\)
Use order of operations. Evaluate the exponent first.
\(20(0.8)^2 =20(0.8 \cdot 0.8)=20(0.64)\)
Then multiply.
\( 20(0.64)=12.8\)
\( 20(0.8)^2 =12.8\)
